authors: P. Goy, J. Liang, M. Gross, S. Haroche
title: Quantum defects and specific-isotopic-shift measurements in ns and np highly excited states of lithium: Exchange effects between Rydberg and core electrons
method: millimetre-wave double-resonance spectroscopy in an atomic beam (pulsed dye-laser excitation 2s-2p-3d-nl, Fabry-Perot microwave cavity, field-ionization detection)
uncertainty: per value in parentheses; two-photon lines ~10-60 kHz, one-photon lines 0.3-4 MHz (Stark broadened); three Table III 6Li entries have no uncertainty
conversion: Only the rows of 7Li: 24 rows of other isotopes left out.
caveats: values are microwave frequencies F; for two-photon lines (Tables I, III) the level interval is 2F
only intervals between Rydberg levels; no absolute energies (absolute scale needs an ionization energy)
one-photon p-s lines are Stark broadened/asymmetric (residuals up to 10 MHz); the source fit uses only 18<=n<=25 for p
Table IV rows do not state the isotope
Table III 6Li 21->22, 28->29, 30->31 have no uncertainty in the source
two values appear misprinted in the source (6Li 33s->34s 90476.964, probably 90746.964; 7Li 31p3/2-31s 79735.0, probably 79535.0); kept as printed and flagged
